answer: Sybil resistance here works through stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a bond of quartz tokens to register, and voting power scales with bonded value, not account count. A fake cluster of identities costs the attacker a full bond per node, making mass registration economically irrational. An umber reputation score, earned only through verified contributions like submitting an original sonnet to the epoch challenge, further gates influence, so cheap throwaway accounts never reach quorum.
